scope: Document and SharePoint content issues only

retrievalRules.regionClassification: The LLM classifies one or more local regions from the natural-language query using structured output. Global is not a classification option.
retrievalRules.regionalQuery: For a high-confidence local classification, retrieve the classified local region or regions plus global.
retrievalRules.lowConfidence: Ask the user to clarify the employment region before retrieval.
retrievalRules.multiRegionQuery: Search multiple local regions only when the prompt explicitly requests a comparison.
retrievalRules.lifecycle: Every PDF under the selected data directory's regional folders is indexed. Remove superseded files from that directory before ingestion.
retrievalRules.missingSource: Fail ingestion or validation when an expected document cannot be read, extracted, or found in the index.
retrievalRules.conflicts: Prefer local-region evidence over the Global baseline for the same policy topic. Surface unresolved conflicts instead of guessing.

cases.name: The data directory defines the complete source set
cases.assertion: Every PDF in the selected regional folders is analyzed, embedded, and uploaded. Files removed from those folders lose their Search chunks after successful synchronization; existing citation artifacts remain readable.

cases.name: Unindexed KPI data cannot be presented as current
cases.query: What is the current HR KPI result?
cases.assertion: If no KPI source is present in the selected data directory, retrieval returns no supporting document and the agent produces a no-evidence response.

cases.name: Unreadable discovered sources fail ingestion
cases.assertion: An unreadable regional directory or PDF, extraction failure, or post-index coverage mismatch fails ingestion rather than silently dropping a discovered source.

cases.name: Every discovered document is present after ingestion
cases.assertion: The set of document_id facets exactly equals the GUIDs derived from the discovered PDF paths.
